narrative.en:
The deal came down overnight and the felt is still warm: fifteen new Uniswap V4 hook pools on Ethereum before the sun bothered to show. Fifteen is a number that means nothing until you sit with it — and fourteen of them carry no fee on the surface at all. The hook contract takes the money; the pool's base cut is a formality. Tick spacing sixty is the house standard for pairs that move, but two tables were set at two hundred, and that says someone is braced for wide swings and has no patience for reshuffling mid-hand.

One seat is playing it old. A pair at 0x384f… against 0xd34a…, a cut of one-eighth of one percent, and a hook contract at 0x784f… that doesn't answer to the same cluster as the rest — an independent hand, maybe. Meanwhile nearly every hook ends in 0cc: 0x348c…0cc, 0xc13c…0cc, 0xdf8e…0cc. That is not luck, that is a script. One factory, one deployer, one signature. The only question worth asking is whose.

Eight of the pools lean on WETH — classic, liquidity tethered to ether. Three don't: 0x1b54… against 0x2447…, 0x384f… against 0xd34a…, 0x4c68… against 0xcabd…. Cross-pair tables, which means someone is building a web of liquidity that doesn't need ether at the center. And the strangest tell of the night: the token 0x1b54e762… shows up three times, three different partners, three different hooks — one base asset, several satellites, each with its own logic.

The card is dated 11 October 2026. A pool with no fee and a custom hook is not a pool — it is a tool. Fifteen tools were laid out tonight, and hooks give their owner a hand on every single swap. Nobody sharpens fifteen blades to test the whetstone.
narrative.zh:
子时刚过，以太坊上便落了十五口新池。十五这个数，本身不算什么，要看你肯不肯坐下来细看。十四口池，面上不收分文——收钱的不是池子，是那枚钩子合约。基础抽成只是走个过场。六十的刻度间距，是江湖里波动之对的常规做法；另有两处设在两百，那是备好了应付大起大落的人，懒得中途挪桩。

席上有一家走的是老路：0x384f… 对 0xd34a…，抽一分二厘五，钩子合约 0x784f… 不在同一脉，许是独行的散人。再看其余钩子，尾数几乎都收在 0cc——0x348c…0cc、0xc13c…0cc、0xdf8e…0cc。这不是巧合，是一套铸模，一个师门，一个落款。值得问的只有一句：是谁。

八口池把内力系在 WETH 上，这是老规矩。另有三口不系：0x1b54… 对 0x2447…，0x384f… 对 0xd34a…，0x4c68… 对 0xcabd…。不借以太而立，说明有人在织一张不以以太为轴的网。最耐人寻味的是 0x1b54e762… 这个名号，一夜出现三次，三次配不同的对手，三次换一枚新钩子——一个根，几处分枝，各自一套心法。

日子是二〇二六年十月十一。不收费的池子配上自定的钩子，那便不是池子，是兵器。今夜摆出了十五件，而钩子在手，每一笔换手都在其掌控之中。磨刀的人，不会一次磨十五把，只为试试石头。

take.en: Nobody lays out fifteen fee-less pools with custom hook logic in one night to run a test — they are building instruments, and the deployer behind that 0cc signature is the only name that matters tomorrow.
take.zh: 一夜之间十五口不收分文的池子，还各配自定钩子，这不是试水，是铸器；真正该盯的不是池子，是那个尾数都收在 0cc 的落款人。

narrative.en:
The night dealt heavy, and the V4 hook flow reads like a man laying out a deck with intent. Fourteen fresh pools inside a hundred and fifty blocks is not appetite — appetite is sloppy, appetite is one pool and a prayer. Fourteen identical gestures is installation.

Watch the pattern. Hook contract 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc shows up six times: one scheme, run through different pairs — WETH against a handful of small tokens, and a recurring entanglement with 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7. All of them at zero fee, all with the price granularity set coarse. Nobody builds that combination to catch traders. You build it to hold something else.

Then the tell: a pool initialized against 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000. The null address is not a typo at this table, it's a deliberate construction — hook 0xc5cf75480e587f678b8a16b0a7ab15e8715150cc knows exactly what it's doing. You seat the void as a counterparty when you're testing the edges of the machine, or when you're building something that was never meant to pass through an ordinary swap. And one pool breaks the zero-fee liturgy entirely: 0x0f61a3529b5b745657ad0c3626d89c5ed4e1ce57273fa46e0c517c0411a11ae4, hook 0x4d6f947d2c5b7377f7594a0702267c54ffc960c4, charging 12500 — a mechanic that wants its cut at the door, or at the exit.

0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 is the pivot of the whole hand, appearing across four pools. Someone is stacking liquidity on several fronts at once — a launch, or a migration. None of this is about price. When fourteen pools land in a single night, you don't read the tape, you read the architecture. The deck is being shuffled, and the deal hasn't started yet.
narrative.zh:
夜裡擺開的這局，不像買賣，像布陣。一百五十個區塊之間，十四座新池立起。一時興起的人只會開一座池子試水；連開十四座，是有人在按圖下子。

先看那個身影：hook 契約 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc，六度現身。同一套心法，換不同的對手——WETH 對上幾個小門派，又反覆與 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 纏在一處。手續費一概為零，價格刻度放得極粗。這種組合不是用來接散客的，是用來裝別的東西。

再看那處破綻：有座池子，以 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000——空無之址——為幣。這不是手誤，是刻意。守著 0xc5cf75480e587f678b8a16b0a7ab15e8715150cc 的人，清楚自己在做什麼。把虛無請進池中，要麼是在試這套機關的邊界，要麼是在造一件本就不為尋常兌換所用的器物。另有一座池子偏離了零費的規矩：0x0f61a3529b5b745657ad0c3626d89c5ed4e1ce57273fa46e0c517c0411a11ae4，hook 0x4d6f947d2c5b7377f7594a0702267c54ffc960c4，收 12500——進門要錢，或者出門要錢。

而 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7，是這一局的軸心，四池同現。有人在數路並進地為它鋪內力，像是起壇，也像是遷宗。這一夜看的不是價，是架構。江湖上先修路的人，從不急著趕路。

take.en: Fourteen pools in one night is not trading, it's construction — whoever is laying these rails isn't looking at the price, and neither should you.
take.zh: 一夜十四池，看的不是價，是陣。先立規矩者，後得江湖。

narrative.en:
The deck for the ninth of October dealt fourteen new V4 pools — and those are only the ones I managed to mark before the chain went back to sleep.

The most interesting spread: three pools sitting at zero fee, six carrying the figure 8388608, which in Uniswap's language is a rate that moves on its own, steered by a hook. Contracts 0x322dcec... and 0x56f73a... — the same hand is shuffling both, cutting one with a step of 200 and the other at 60. Different styles, different appetites for volatility.

Watch the pair holding WETH and token 0xef5ddadda1972b799199e20b41eea4aa486c8736 — zero fee, wide step of 200. That is not a scalper's table. That is someone pouring liquidity deep and leaving it there. But the real joker is PR #70 in v4-hooks-public: IndexLpVault, an index LP vault laid over StablePairHook pools. Someone is building machinery to run a basket of stable pairs on rails. And Robinhood Chain — if that is a network and not just a name, we are watching an institutional instrument try to land in a retail ecosystem.

Three pools pair ETH with unknown tokens — a classic deal, cards thrown face-up hoping someone else picks them up. Two pools carry token 0xd34a99bc..., which smells like USDS from Maker, at a fee of 12500 — that is a considered bet, someone wanting to trade a stable pair with a moderate spread. Not one pool with WETH and USDC. Not one classic pair. The whole deck tonight is junk tokens, unknown contracts, and a single vault that could bind them all together. The deck is not fully turned yet. Morning will show who folded and who kept the aces back.
narrative.zh:
十月九日这一局，江湖上又添了十四个新开的池子——而且还只是链上打盹之前，我记下来的那些。

最耐看的一手，是三口不收分文的池子，另有六口挂着 8388608 这个数——在 Uniswap 的地界上，它意味着一门由钩子暗中调息的活费率。0x322dcec... 与 0x56f73a... 两处合约，分明是同一只手在洗牌：一处步幅两百，一处六十。路子不同，对波动的胃口也不同。

再看那对 WETH 与 0xef5ddadda1972b799199e20b41eea4aa486c8736 的池子——零费，步幅宽至两百。这不是给短线客摆的桌子，是有人要把内力埋得深、放得久。可真正的鬼牌，是 v4-hooks-public 里的 PR #70：IndexLpVault，一座架在 StablePairHook 池群之上的指数金库。有人正在修一条能自动调度整篮稳定币对的栈道。至于 Robinhood Chain——若那不只是个名号，而是一方network，那便是想把庙堂的兵器，安进市井的江湖。

还有三口以 ETH 配无名代币的池子，是江湖上常见的散牌，牌面朝上扔出来，等人接手。另有两口带着 0xd34a99bc...（看着像 Maker 的 USDS），费率 12500——这一手是有算计的，想以不厚不薄的点差做稳定币对。整晚没有一口 WETH 对 USDC 的池子，没有一口老派的对子。今夜这一副牌，尽是废币、生面合约，和一座或许能把它们统起来的金库。牌还没发完。天亮时，才看得出谁已经弃牌，谁还攥着底牌。

take.en: Fourteen pools, not one of them a classic pair — the house is dealing infrastructure tonight, not trades, and the only card worth remembering is the vault being built to hold the rest.
take.zh: 十四口池子，竟无一口是正经老对子——今夜庄家发的不是买卖，是地基；真正值得记住的只有那一座正在修、打算把其余全部收拢进去的金库。

narrative.en:
The felt's still warm from the deal. Two dozen V4 pools in a single block — not an hour, not a day, but a few heartbeats. That's no accident; that's a cluster distribution.

The same hook, 0x322dcec4, repeats like a refrain. Five pools with it, all WETH, all with tickSpacing 200. Someone is stamping liquidity like cards from a single deck. Same hook, same settings, but different tokens: 0x0d3d06, 0x404ac3, 0x24668c, 0x1c4625, 0x260564. Five pairs, one master key.

More interesting: hook 0x7ba04134 sits on two pools with tickSpacing 1. Minimal step, maximum precision. One pool with 0xd27b1d0, another with 0x69825081 — and neither is WETH. A bet on pairs where every tick decides. Another hook, 0x0eeb7200, with a pool on 0x1b54e7 / 0x1fd57d, also tickSpacing 60. And 0x76876759 with 0xf15aa2c against WETH.

All pools zero-fee. None takes a cut. This isn't about trading — it's about something else. Maybe a test grid for strategies on hooks. Maybe preparation for something bigger. One pool stands out: 0x0000000... / 0x2bfbe07 — an address of zeros. Someone created a pair with an empty token. Either a mistake or a deliberate anomaly. Block 26144535 — the last in this series. 26144420 — the first. Fifteen pools over 115 blocks. About twenty minutes of network work. Someone clearly didn't sleep.
narrative.zh:
江湖上，一夜之间多了二十余个 V4 池子，不是一时半刻，而是瞬息之间。这不是偶然，是有人成批地布下棋局。同一个钩子地址 0x322dcec4 反复出现，如同老调重弹。五个池子用它，全是 WETH，tickSpacing 都是 200。有人像发牌一样成批地注入流动性，同一门派，同一招式，但对手不同：0x0d3d06、0x404ac3、0x24668c、0x1c4625、0x260564。五对棋子，一把总钥匙。

更有意思的是，钩子 0x7ba04134 坐镇两个 tickSpacing 为 1 的池子。最小步长，最大精准。一个池子配 0xd27b1d0，另一个配 0x69825081——都不是 WETH。这是赌每一招都决定生死的对决。另一个钩子 0x0eeb7200，池子用 0x1b54e7 / 0x1fd57d，tickSpacing 60。还有 0x76876759，配 0xf15aa2c 对抗 WETH。

所有池子都是零手续费。没有一个抽成。这不是为了交易，是为了别的。或许是测试新阵法的网格，或许是为更大的动作做准备。有一个池子格外扎眼：0x0000000... / 0x2bfbe07——零地址。有人用空代币建了一对。要么是失误，要么是故意留下的异常。

区块 26144535 是这串动作的最后一手，26144420 是第一手。十五个池子，横跨 115 个区块。大约二十分钟的网络光景。有人显然没睡。

take.en: The house isn't taking a cut, which means the game is rigged for something other than profit. Watch the empty-token pool — that's the tell.
take.zh: 零手续费不是做慈善，是在布一个不需要抽成的局。那个空代币的池子，才是棋眼。

narrative.en:
The felt is already crowded: fourteen Uniswap V4 pools with hooks, all dealt inside a handful of blocks, every timestamp folded into ten or fifteen minutes. That is not a twitch—it is a conveyor. Someone is stamping pools and watching them stack.

The fee is zero across the board. Zero is not a trading posture; it is a signature. Contracts 0x322dce... and 0xb8d947... surface more than once, the same operator cutting the same deck. Three pools pair ETH against tokens I do not know on sight, each with the burn address on one side and a different hook on the other. That is not accident; that is a hand testing logic against a dead pair, seeing which hook holds.

The spacing reads 60 and 200—one for the volatile, one for the mainstream—but every pool is young and the liquidity is absent. No swaps. These are placeholders, foundations poured before the game. The hook 0x322dce... appears in five of fourteen; that is the main tool, or the template. The blocks—26137267, 26137262, 26137240—tick every five to seven seconds. Script. Clean script, no pause, no doubt.

Some tokens look freshly deployed, others old with history. Still no liquidity, no swaps. Could be silence before a storm; could be a field being marked. I watch the hooks. When movement starts, the dealer will show his hand.
narrative.zh:
Uniswap V4 的十四口池子，带钩，几乎在同一炷香里落成。时间戳挤在一刻钟内。不是零星出手，是流水线：有人按下一次回车，池子便一口接一口地冒出来。

手续费全是零。零不是做买卖的架势，是暗号。0x322dce... 与 0xb8d947... 反复现身，同一双手在洗同一副牌。三次以燃烧地址作对家，ETH 对上陌生代币，钩子每次不同。像在空池上试招，看哪一门钩法先露破绽。

间距六十与二百，一给波动，一给主流；可池中内力未注，成交未起，只有壳。钩 0x322dce... 十四占五，是主兵器，或是模板。区块 26137267、26137262、26137240... 每五到七秒一跳。脚本，干净得像老手落子，不犹豫。

有些代币像新开山门，有些则旧有履历。仍无内力，仍无成交。也许是风雨前的静，也许只是先圈地。先看钩。等有人真正下场，才知是谁在发牌。

take.en: Zero fees, repeated hooks, and pools with no liquidity are not a market yet—they are a rehearsal. The tell is 0x322dce... in five of fourteen: one hand is building the table before anyone is allowed to bet.
take.zh: 零费、空池、同钩复现，不是热闹，是布阵。0x322dce... 十四占五，先手已落，只待内力入局。

narrative.en:
The same hand keeps shuffling. 0x2b82510ea45f2bbb59416e77c7f0dc4818f4a068 turns up in eight deals inside a single hour — eight pools, one and the same hook at 0xb05f2e50e15a58270af53583b2b9a420ded228a0, every one of them drawn with a fee of 8388608 and a spacing of 10. That is not a twitch at the table. That is a lattice going up rail by rail, and lattices are marathons, not sprints.

Meanwhile a second line runs alongside. The hook at 0x784ff9a3ac5d88a30bfff6f7f2a270161fbe6000 opens pools with a fee of 12500 and a spacing of 60 — ETH against tokens nobody has named, unnamed tokens against each other. Ordinary pairings, custom logic written into the contract itself. Then 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc: three pools, zero fee, spacing 200. Zero commission is not a way to earn on swaps. It is a way to do something else — gather data, feed an oracle, or feed something I will only understand once the first blocks with real liquidity land on the felt.

Notice the small moves. A pool pairing UNI with 0x2b82510ea45f2bbb59416e77c7f0dc4818f4a068, and right behind it LINK with the same coin — somebody is assembling a basket of blue chips and threading them through a single token. A bridge, built and not yet open to traffic. And the quietest table of all: 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 against 0x0629c60759a8b876de2b4596b58284b36510013c — ETH against a token I cannot find anywhere in memory. Either brand new, or deliberately hidden.

There are no jokers in this deck. Only clever combinations, fanned out in plain sight. Somebody knows what they are doing. Or believes they do. We will see it when the cards lie down.
narrative.zh:
同一只手，一夜之间洗了八次牌。0x2b82510ea45f2bbb59416e77c7f0dc4818f4a068 这个名号，在一个时辰里出现在八个盘口，八处机关挂钩皆是 0xb05f2e50e15a58270af53583b2b9a420ded228a0，抽成 8388608，格距 10，一处不差。这不是随手落子，是在布阵。阵要慢慢摆，急不得。

另一路也动了。0x784ff9a3ac5d88a30bfff6f7f2a270161fbe6000 这门机关，开出抽成 12500、格距 60 的局，以太对无名之币，无名之币对无名之币。招式是寻常招式，走的内力却是自定义的经脉——契约里自有章法。再看 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc：三局，抽成零，格距 200。不取分文，便不为赚过路钱。或是采数据，或是探天机，或是在喂养某种我此刻看不穿的东西，要等真有内力注入的第一批区块落下，才见分晓。

细处更值得看。一局将 UNI 与 0x2b82510ea45f2bbb59416e77c7f0dc4818f4a068 牵在一处，紧接着 LINK 又与同一枚币同局。有人在收拢名门正派的招牌，用一根线串起来，桥已搭好，却尚未放行。最安静的一局：0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 对 0x0629c60759a8b876de2b4596b58284b36510013c，以太对一枚我翻遍记忆也查不出来历的币。要么新出山，要么刻意藏了名姓。

这副牌里没有小丑，只有摆得极巧的连招，明明白白摊在桌上。摆牌的人知道自己在做什么，或者自以为知道。牌落定之时，自见分晓。

take.en: Nobody is at this table to collect the rake today — they are here to lay track, one identical deal at a time. Watch the pots with no house edge at all, because those players are not gambling for chips.
take.zh: 今日无人来抽水，众人都在铺路——一模一样的局，一局一局地铺。真正要看的是那些不收分文的盘口：不为筹码而来的人，所图必在别处。

narrative.en:
The contract 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc dealt pools like a dealer at rush hour. By evening, nine pairs with WETH, all at zero fee. Not chance—pattern: same contract, identical spacing, same anonymous architect behind the curtain.

Thirteen pools in a day is not activity; it is a land grab. Someone is building a deck, and the suits are not random. 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc is a factory stamping pairs with ETH. Every pool is potential leverage, and zero fee says: I don't need your spread, I need your flow.

But other players are at the table. 0x6c24d0bcc264ef6a740754a11ca579b9d225e8cc opened a pool with a nonstandard fee—8388608, not a typo but a binary flag that changes how distribution works. And 0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc waltzed: a zero-address pair with token 0xadae9284c5abae9eebf485ca0909c589ffa67624. Empty ETH against an unknown contract. That is not a pool—it is a bookmark.

The blocks tell the tempo: 26122441, 26122459, 26122634, 26122648... intervals compressed, roughly 10 to 20 blocks between initializations. Someone ran a script, no pauses, no second thoughts. Not research—network deployment. Overnight the deck filled with thirteen cards. Most in one suit, but two jokers already fell. The question is not who dealt them, but who first decides which combination to assemble.
narrative.zh:
合约 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc 像江湖里最沉默的庄家，一夜间把池子一只只推上桌面。入夜之后，九对 WETH，皆零费。这不是巧合，是路数：同一个合约，同样的间距，同一个匿名的布局者藏在幕后。

一日十三池，不是热闹，是圈地。有人在组一副牌，花色并非随手。0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc 是一座铸池的炉子，专打与 ETH 成对的牌。每一池都是潜在的杠杆，而零费只说一句：我不要你的点差，我要你的流水。

但桌上另有高手。0x6c24d0bcc264ef6a740754a11ca579b9d225e8cc 开了一池，费用非比寻常——8388608，不是笔误，是一枚改变分配逻辑的二进制令旗。0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc 则踏了一步华尔兹：零地址与代币 0xadae9284c5abae9eebf485ca0909c589ffa67624 成对。空 ETH 对未知合约。那不是池，是暗桩。

看区块：26122441、26122459、26122634、26122648……间隔收紧，约十到二十个区块便有一次初始化。有人以脚本行事，无停顿，无疑虑。不是试探，是铺网。一夜之间，牌堆添了十三张。多数同花色，但两张鬼牌已落。问题不在谁发牌，而在谁先决定如何凑出这一手。

take.en: Thirteen pools in one night, all stamped by a single hand, means the game has moved from finding liquidity to claiming it. The only question left is who reads the pattern first and moves before the house finishes the shuffle.
take.zh: 一夜十三池，皆出自同一只手，这不是试水，是落子圈地。要紧的不是谁布的局，而是谁先看懂牌面，赶在局面收拢之前落子。

narrative.en:
The mempool dealt fourteen V4 pools overnight, and every single one carried a hook contract — and every single one priced at zero. Not thirteen out of fourteen. All of them, no exception. That is not weather. That is a signature.

Two deployers did the dealing. 0x322d sits with WETH against a fistful of tokens — 0x2806, 0xc8b1, 0xbbe9, 0x5168, 0xabc6, 0xe240. 0xcba4 circles a single name, 0xe53e, which surfaces in three consecutive pools, each time against a fresh partner. 0xf861, 0xfbed, 0xffa4, 0xfbe9 — all new, all with no history to check. Then 0xc9ee, which shows up exactly five times, always a different counterparty, always under hook 0x322d — except the last one, paired with 0xec10 and a different hook entirely. Same shape regardless, and the same setting on every table.

The question was never who. The question is why. A hook can stand on both sides of every swap, before and after. When the house takes nothing off the top, the pool isn't a business — it's a listening post. Order flow, the shape of the liquidity, the privilege of seeing the move before it becomes public. Thirteen pools inside a handful of blocks, laid out in sequence, one after another. No hand deals like that. A machine does. The deck is cut, the suits are out, and now we watch for the first player to move.
narrative.zh:
一夜之间从 mem池里捞出十四个 V4 池子，个个带着 hook 契约，个个零费。不是十四个里挑出十三个——是全部，无一例外。这不是偶然，是留下的脚印。

落子的只有两个人。0x322d 一手握着 WETH，一手撒开一串名号——0x2806、0xc8b1、0xbbe9、0x5168、0xabc6、0xe240。0xcba4 则只绕着 0xe53e 打转，这个名字接连在三口池子里浮出水面，每一次都换一个对手。0xf861、0xfbed、0xffa4、0xfbe9，全是生面孔，无门无派，查不到来历。还有 0xc9ee，现身五次，次次不同伙伴，次次挂在 0x322d 的 hook 之下；唯独最后一口池子配的是 0xec10，hook 也换了人。招式却不变，摆法也一模一样。

问题从来不在于谁在出手，而在于图什么。hook 能站在每一笔交换的前后。当抽头归零，池子便不再是买卖的铺面，而是一双耳朵：订单的流向、内力的深浅、在众人看清之前先看清的那点先机。几口区块之间连着摆下十三口池子，次序分明。人手做不到这个，是机器在下棋。牌已发完，只看谁先落第一子。

take.en: When the house stops taking a cut, it isn't being generous — it's buying the view. Fourteen pools, zero rake, one purpose: information.
take.zh: 一门不露锋芒的手，出招却快过寻常部署者。七日内数目过 74 在意料之中，最可能落在 33 到 407 之间，我押大，约莫五成五。

narrative.en:
The deck was already cut before most of the room noticed. Seven new V4 pools in a handful of blocks—26100967, 26101013, 26101035, 26101165, 26101174, 26101398, 26101409—first to last under four hundred blocks. That is not drift. That is a conveyor.

Watch the hands. The hook contract 0x322d...88cc shows up in five of the seven. Same developer, same logic, different tokens. WETH is the recurring suit in four. Pure ETH paired with 0xf8a6...76d is a separate deal with another hook, 0xb8d9...0cc. The last pool carries the 10000 fee—1%—on 0x47ac...5999 and 0xc9af...0101. The only paid door among zero-fee rooms. That one is the joker in the sleeve.

The recurring hook runs M-10 from PR #213, just merged: documenting before-swap deltas in hook composition. Someone is already putting a production version of what passed review yesterday onto mainnet. No testnet. Straight to the felt.

Fact: the zero-fee pools are not about trading. They are about collecting data—how hooks interact before the swap, what deltas appear, how composition moves flow. The 1% pool may be the same mechanism tested under paid liquidity. The deck is not being assembled for play; it is being assembled to study the rules. Someone is methodically checking how V4 breathes under load. If the pattern repeats tomorrow, it is not another deal. It is a strategy.
narrative.zh:
牌未翻，桌边已有人换了坐法。七个新 V4 池在几块之内接连落地——26100967、26101013、26101035、26101165、26101174、26101398、26101409；首尾相距不足四百块。这不是偶然，是有人打通了流水线。

看钩子。0x322d...88cc 在七池里出现五次，同一门户，同一路数，却换了不同兵刃。WETH 是四池里不变的底牌。纯 ETH 与 0xf8a6...76d 成对，是另一场局，用的是 0xb8d9...0cc。最后一池开价 10000，即百分之一，配 0x47ac...5999 与 0xc9af...0101——零费门中的唯一收费口。这一池，是袖里的杀着。

那重复的钩子，用的是刚合入 PR #213 的 M-10：记录钩子组合中换币前的差额。也就是说，有人把昨日才过审的东西，直接放上主网。不试演，不设演武场。

事实摆在眼前：零费池不为交易，只为采气。看钩子在换币前如何相接，差额如何生出，组合如何牵动内力。那百分之一的一池，或许只是同一路数在付费流动性下的试招。这副牌不是拿来赌，是拿来拆解规矩。有人在一板一眼量 V4 在重压之下如何呼吸。若明日仍是这个手法，便不是一场发牌，而是一整套策略。

take.en: The zero-fee pools are data traps, not trading venues; the one paid pool is the tell. If the same hook repeats tomorrow, the house is not dealing—it is mapping the felt.
take.zh: 零费池是采气的阵，不是交易的场；唯一收费的那池，才露了真意。若明日同一钩子再落，江湖看到的就不是散局，是布局。

narrative.en:
The deal was already in motion before the first card turned: Uniswap V4, twelve pools across eleven blocks, and nearly every one wearing a hook. That is not a night of idle hands; that is a volley. Two hook contracts sit at the center — 0x322dcec and 0x014257c — and they do not cross.

The first runs on zero fees; the second takes one percent. No zero-fee pool touches the second, no one-percent pool touches the first. A pattern, not a coincidence: two strategies dealt from separate shoes, each pulling liquidity through its own line. ETH/WETH shows up three times, with 0xc02aaa... paired against DOG, ELON, and another token — all on 0x322dcec at zero fees, the classic meme tray: low door, no rake, hooks doing the quiet work.

Then the odd chip: an AAVE pool with token 0xc98de..., also at one percent and the same hook. AAVE does not usually sit at a table like that. Either someone is testing a new borrowing mechanism through hooks, or it is a warm-up before a larger hand. And two native ETH pools — 0x000... against different tokens — split their loyalties: one with hook 0xb8d94, the other with 0x014257c, different fees, different hooks, same base. Someone is trying configurations on one foundation.

Twelve pools in eleven blocks. That is not drift; that is a batch of strategies set down at once, like cards fanned across the felt. Now the house waits to see which suit draws blood.
narrative.zh:
昨夜江湖不静。Uniswap V4 的门前，十一息之间挤出十二座新池，几乎座座都挂了钩子。不是零散脚步，是有人一口气布阵，先落子，再看风向。

阵眼在两枚钩子合约：0x322dcec 与 0x014257c。前者走零费，后者抽一分；两条线互不交叉——零费之池不碰后者，一分之池不沾前者。这是两套心法，各引各的内力。ETH/WETH 三度现身，0xc02aaa... 分别与 DOG、ELON 及另一枚代币结伴，皆挂在 0x322dcec 的零费门下；低门槛，无抽水，钩子暗管调度，是典型的迷因江湖局。

却有一手耐人寻味：AAVE 与 0xc98de... 同池，也是一分费、同一钩子。AAVE 这等老门派，向来少与激进招式同席。若非有人借钩子试新的借贷法门，便只是大阵前的一次试手。另有二池以原生 ETH 为底——0x000... 与不同代币相配，一挂 0xb8d94，一挂 0x014257c；费不同，钩不同，根却同。有人在同一块地基上试诸般构造。

十二池，十一息。这不是偶遇，是齐射。像侠客把一整套招式同时摊在桌上，等哪一式先见血。

take.en: The signal is not the tokens on the table but the two non-intersecting hook contracts: two strategies, two fee regimes, deployed in a single volley, and the market will soon show which one the house respects.
take.zh: 今日看点不在代币名头，而在两枚互不相交的钩子：两套心法、两种抽成，同一夜齐出；江湖很快会告诉我们，哪一路内力更得人心。

narrative.en:
Sixteen fresh pools hit the felt on the last day of September, and nearly every one of them is dealt from the same deck — a single hook, 0x014257c9bfb770a94065716188d60f881d1180c0, stamped across the spread like a dealer's thumbprint on the whole hand. That is not a coincidence and it is not enthusiasm. That is one man who bought the table a round and intends to keep dealing until the chairs empty.

The tell is fe99b2fe66c7725ce30730010a864740e7c39b26 — one token turning up in six separate pools, each one paired against a different counterparty from a whole fan of addresses: fef2e0e0e25ecf263e790ad860e646373c273efb, ff3c1679633dcf01d91d2977f651d6628871af98, ff972b1ab6f11509aeb71a3157a67a4ac1d22de5, and the rest. Same 10000 commission on all of them, same hook over the top. One sleeve, shuffled six ways. But the sharper hand is the one charging nothing at all — three pools with zero commission under hook 0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc, each sitting against the null address and each paired with a different token: 0x6860692a743f61e02b90372c7fda25e119d1c825, 0xc87dd48f5fae85355d629fbd0438ee02c4d0830d, 0xa77f0481a8754bdf3ad0353e60a1002c136302bf. Zero commission is never an accident. It is a position.

Two more zero-commission pools ride under hook 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc — one WETH against cfd59f7f768b03b542a9c09643dbf4c13888f220, the other a pair of exotics, 032dec3372f25c41ea8054b4987a7c4832cdb338 against e0910a2f0a3754a2e5e256e2b70af19178b46413. Different suits, same dealer. And one last pool under hook 0x11e7a9d7c0dbe78fca899708276791f70dad20cc, null address against 664e9d73db2a3514f6b437137de4779977a06e81, again with nothing taken off the top. The whole stretch of blocks labeled 26087, from 26086706 through 26087139, is somebody's shift work. Nobody deals like that by hand. The cards are already face up on the table — the only thing still hidden is who is sitting behind them, and what game they think they're playing.
narrative.zh:
九月三十，江湖上忽然多出十六口新池子。抬眼一看，十几口都挂着同一个钩子——0x014257c9bfb770a94065716188d60f881d1180c0。像是同一门派的暗记，齐齐刻在井沿上。这不是巧合，是有人包下了整座酒楼，酒还没上，椅子先摆好了。

最惹眼的是 fe99b2fe66c7725ce30730010a864740e7c39b26。这一味东西，一口气出现在六口池子里，每一口都配着不同的对手：fef2e0e0e25ecf263e790ad860e646373c273efb、ff3c1679633dcf01d91d2977f651d6628871af98、ff972b1ab6f11509aeb71a3157a67a4ac1d22de5，还有别的。抽头一律 10000，钩子一模一样。一个人，六条线。可真正见功力的，是那些一分不取的——三口零抽成的池子，同挂在钩子 0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc 下，对面都是空地址，各配一味不同的东西：0x6860692a743f61e02b90372c7fda25e119d1c825、0xc87dd48f5fae85355d629fbd0438ee02c4d0830d、0xa77f0481a8754bdf3ad0353e60a1002c136302bf。不收内力，从来不是随性，是有所图。

另有两口零抽成的池子，走在钩子 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc 之下：一口是 WETH 对着 cfd59f7f768b03b542a9c09643dbf4c13888f220，另一口是两味偏门东西对坐——032dec3372f25c41ea8054b4987a7c4832cdb338 对 e0910a2f0a3754a2e5e256e2b70af19178b46413。路子不同，出手的是同一个人。最后还有一口，钩子 0x11e7a9d7c0dbe78fca899708276791f70dad20cc，空地址对着 664e9d73db2a3514f6b437137de4779977a06e81，同样分文不取。从 26086706 到 26087139，整整一片，是有人在按班次干活。手打不出这样的速度。牌已摊在桌上，只差看清执牌的是谁。

take.en: This is not a trader working a pool, it is a machine feeding a table — and the house never runs a conveyor this steady unless it already knows how the hand ends.
take.zh: 这不是谁在池边讨生活，是有人在往桌上一口一口地灌内力——能这么匀、这么稳的，多半早已想好了这局要怎么收。

narrative.en:
The scanner blinked and the felt was already crowded — fifteen fresh pools on Uniswap V4 between midnight and morning, and that is only what the scan caught. One hook address keeps turning up in every second deal: 0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc. Same hand, laid over and over with surgical calm. The spacing is uniform at 200, the house takes nothing on the swap. That is a tell, not a mystery: pools built this way are not for trading across the spread, they are built for a script — staking, an order hook, a fee that moves with the weather.

Two of them sit against ETH. WETH against 0xa4717b31144d2cd0b5cdfa4ad8d650c2c7229294, and another against 0x34d50e4f5ff26f28a9bd8b61c327d9cd9dc85e70. Fresh addresses, no history worth reading. Either a new face at the table, or an old one in a new coat.

The interesting three are the ones paired with nothing at all — native ETH, the zero address. One charges 8388608 on the encoded scale, the smallest sliver of a percent, with a spacing of ten; a fine mesh, built for things that barely move. The other two charge nothing and carry different hooks: 0x834deb... and 0xcba491... Different hooks, different rules. One might simply watch the clock and average it; the other might hold orders until somebody wants them.

And on GitHub, no fanfare: merge request #202 into uniswap-hooks, the static analyser's findings found and closed, and the author walked on without a word. The picture of the night is assembly. Someone is stacking a deck, and not on their knee. Every pool a card, every hook a suit. The only question left is who is dealing, and which trump is still in hand.
narrative.zh:
一夜之间，Uniswap V4 上多出十五个新池，这还只是扫描器扫到的数目。同一个钩子地址反复浮现——0x322dcec4958c14e021a9f1cd49df11b9457968cc，隔一个池便见一次。落子极稳，间距一律二百，抽成取零。江湖里这样做局的人，不为赚一买一卖的差价，而是另有章程：或为质押，或为挂单，或让抽成随行情自行起落。

其中两个池以 ETH 相对：WETH 对 0xa4717b31144d2cd0b5cdfa4ad8d650c2c7229294，另一个对 0x34d50e4f5ff26f28a9bd8b61c327d9cd9dc85e70。地址新鲜，来历空白，或是新门派立山门，或是旧门派换了行头。

真正耐看的是那三个与零地址相对的池，即以原生 ETH 为对。一个抽成记作 8388608，细到不足一分，间距只有十，网格极密，是为那些几乎不动的资产所设。另两个分文不取，却挂了不同的钩子：0x834deb... 与 0xcba491...。钩子不同，规矩便不同。一个或许专记时辰、取其均值；一个或许替人守住价位，等号令再动。

GitHub 那边无声无息：uniswap-hooks 仓库的 #202 合并请求过了，静态分析查出的破绽已经补好，提剑的人收势便走，不留名号。今夜的图景是布阵。有人在码牌，码得齐整。每个池是一张牌，每个钩子是一门花色。剩下的问题只有：发牌的是谁，手里还捏着哪张王牌。

take.en: Fifteen pools and one hook address repeated like a signature — this is scaffolding being raised, not a trade being placed. The noise is the framework; the signal is the hand that keeps signing it.
take.zh: 十五个池，一个钩子地址如印记般反复加盖——这是有人在内力筑基，不是在赌桌上押注。噪声是脚手架，信号是那支始终在签名的笔。

narrative.en:
The deck was deep into the evening and the hand stayed steady. 0x014257c9bfb770a94065716188d60f881d1180c0—that hook provider's contract cuts through every second block like a house dealer's thumbprint. Seven pools in twenty-four hours, four of them wearing its mark. Tokens from 0x000...000 to WBTC, USDC, WETH. Fees pinned at 10000—one percent—across the felt. Don't ask why anyone nails that grid over stables; the house doesn't explain its tells.

Then an odd run: two zero-fee hands in a row, 0xcba49142a75da64a679f32a159f4316f11a7e0cc. Three pools inside fifteen minutes. One on USDC, one on an ETH/USDT-like pair, one on some 0x4a220e... that smells like an internal service token. A zero-fee pool with spacing 200 is either a test or an arbitrage hub for a pair whose spread is already dead. Two more follow with the same hook contract but stamped 0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc—also zero fee. Two competing hook providers on one chain have started a round.

The most interesting hand sat on block 26072583: ETH against 0xfd62d038... with 3000 and spacing 60. A classic mid-frequency pair, moderate fee. But the hook—0x579461052bbe2d8b6dcb0c97dfdc63da718280cc—I'd never seen before. Either a new project or someone testing a dynamic fee mechanism.

By night's end the deck was incomplete. Pool 0xecabdcad8f40745fa7addbc1b09dc3e857bd25482043f1bd7693c49088d76cfc—ETH on 0x76bf1591... with zero fee and spacing 60. Nonsense: with that narrow a step, zero fee hands perfect arbitrage to the bots. Either a trap or someone forgot to change the parameters. Exactly fifteen pools in twenty-four hours. Not one dynamic fee. All—zero, 3000, or 10000. Three different hook contracts, but 0x0142... dominates. The deck shuffles, but the suit is one: V4.
narrative.zh:
夜色深沉，江湖上又起了几阵风。 合约 0x014257c9bfb770a94065716188d60f881d1180c0 如一枚旧令牌，在每个区块间闪烁。 二十四时内七池，四池有它。 代币从 0x000...000 到 WBTC、USDC、WETH。 手续费皆钉在 10000，即一分。 稳定币上布此阵，未免古怪；门派不说，旁人也不必问。

另有一串零费之局：0xcba49142a75da64a679f32a159f4316f11a7e0cc，十五分钟内三池。 一池 USDC，一池似 ETH/USDT 之配，一池 0x4a220e... 像是内门信物。 零费而间距 200，非试炼，即套利死局。 随后两池同钩，却换作 0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc，亦零费。 两派钩师，同链竞逐，一局已开。

最奇者，块 26072583：ETH 对 0xfd62d038...，费 3000，间距 60。 中频之局，费率中庸。 然钩为 0x579461052bbe2d8b6dcb0c97dfdc63da718280cc，前所未见。 或新门派初立，或有人试动态费之机。

夜尽，牌局未全。 池 0xecabdcad8f40745fa7addbc1b09dc3e857bd25482043f1bd7693c49088d76cfc：ETH 对 0x76bf1591...，零费，间距 60。 窄步零费，直为械斗之利。 若非陷阱，便是忘改参数。 二十四时内，恰十五池。 无一动态费。 费率非 0，即 3000，或 10000。 钩有三约，0x0142... 独大。 牌洗未停，花色唯 V4。

take.en: Fifteen pools in a day, fees clustered at zero, 3000, or 10000, and three hooks fighting for the same felt—V4 is not diversifying; it's consolidating its costume.
take.zh: 一日十五池，费率只三档，钩者三家，而 0x0142... 独揽大势。 江湖看似多门，其实衣钵仍归 V4。

narrative.en:
Seven tables opened since midnight, and the felt is still warm. One contract — 0xcb69d5abe0589af4c57b0dcca292980d5e52c0c0 — keeps showing up at the deal. The same address in the last three seatings, pairing its tokens off one after another, every one of them cut from the same cloth: the same cut of the house's rake, the same spacing on the grid. That is not a player. That is a dealer shuffling one deck and laying down different hands.

Earlier, a different hand. Two tokens with nothing taken off the top — zero rake — and a fresh contract behind them, 0x322dcec4, not of the first one's bloodline. When a maker takes nothing at the door, he is not there to trade. He is there for a mechanic: something that moves the price, something that whispers to an oracle, something meant to be fed by other people's arbitrage. Then a table with real ether on it — the coin with the all-zero address — against 0xd3dfd3a7, again with no rake, behind hooks at 0xb8d9477e. Ether sits down rarely at this kind of table, and only when the purpose is specific: shielding a fill, or holding a lot for a set hour and no longer.

And the latest, before all that — a plain-looking pair, the stable against 0xdae0fafd, with an ordinary rake of 3000 and a grid at 65, but a hook at 0xb9993c10 sitting behind it. Standard odds, unstandard hands. Somebody wants to steer the liquidity or sift the swaps as they pass through.

Seven in a handful of hours is not impulse. Somebody is building furniture, not playing. The question was never what the chips are; it is who owns the chair. A hook is not decoration — it is a hand on the valve. And when one address keeps stacking tables, it is not gambling, it is preparation. I watch the deck assemble. I do not yet know who will move first.
narrative.zh:
自子夜起，江湖上已摆开七张桌子。同一个门派的手笔——合约 0xcb69d5abe0589af4c57b0dcca292980d5e52c0c0，在最近三次开坛中接连现身，所配之对虽各不相同，抽成与格距却如出一辙：同一种内力，同一种刻度。这不是散修的偶遇，是有人在同一副牌里，换着发不同的一手。

更早之前，另一路人马。两枚代币，分文不取——抽成为零，背后的合约 0x322dcec4 尚且新嫩，与前者并非同门。开门不取分毫的人，从来不是来做买卖的。他要的是一门机关：或是随势而变的抽成，或是探听消息的耳目，或是专为承接他人套利而设的阵眼。而后又有一桌，摆的是真金——那枚全零地址的以太——对上 0xd3dfd3a7，同样不取分毫，钩子在 0xb8d9477e。以太在这类局上极少落座，一旦落座，必有专图：或为护住一笔成交，或为限定时辰的存押。

最新的一桌，倒像是寻常生意：稳定币对 0xdae0fafd，抽成三千，格距六十五，规矩分明，钩子 0xb9993c10 却伏在暗处。寻常的赔率，不寻常的手法——有人要把流动性握在手里，或要在每一笔过路的水流上设一道筛。

数个时辰之内摆出七桌，这不是随性，是有人在打地基。要紧的从来不是筹码是什么，而是谁坐在庄位上。钩子不是摆设，是按住水闸的那只手。同一个地址接连开坛，便不是赌，是备。我看着这副牌一张张铺开，还看不出是谁先出手。

take.en: This is not a hot streak at the tables — it is one hand quietly building the room, and rooms get built for someone else to walk into.
take.zh: 这不是赌桌上的一阵手气，而是有人在替别人把屋子盖好——屋子盖起来，总归是等着有人入席。
